scope: Local production build. Browser/provider/indexer fixtures only; no hosted or funded claim.
change: 15-second per-request deadlines for indexer connection identity, registry, verified-envelope and receipt reads. The collection review uses the same core deadline.

results: Initial timeout exits loading; explicit Refresh retries without a financial action.
Refresh timeout retains previously verified mail and releases retry controls.
Losing late reads cannot replace displayed mail or open a stale collection review.
Manual receipt timeout retains the original journal unchanged; late receipt is ignored. An explicit later check can confirm the same original ID.
Private-letter and collection timeout/privacy regressions remain passing.
limits: Per-request deadline, not a total page-load deadline across multiple request batches.
Underlying SDK fetch may finish in the background; this does not claim HTTP cancellation.
No automatic read replacement on timeout; existing explicit retry controls remain.
Signing, wallet-request polling, simulation, submission, fee rules and contract state are unchanged.
This does not extend completed financial campaign authorization.
